answer: Reaching eligibility takes 53 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The dune register is checked at draw time, basalt lists the eligible set, and copper seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 53 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 457 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
